description.p: OxTree scans a directory on all cores and shows the result as a sortable tree with percent bars and as a cushion treemap where every file is a rectangle sized by its space and coloured by type. Click a rectangle and the tree jumps to the file.

A File View lists every file largest first with WizTree's search syntax, a File Types view groups them by extension, and a duplicates mode finds files with the same name and size. Cleanup actions open a terminal or a file manager there, delete junk, or run your own command; one key moves things to the trash. Scans can be exported to CSV, also from the command line without a window, and saved as QDirStat cache files.
